original_test_intent: Burn all approved GPUs for the source 12 hours at 40 C with 5 V and 3.3 V rails margined +5%, then verify platform health.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Operator establishes chamber and rail-margin conditions; run approved GPU burn and monitor sensors/errors.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: All intended GPUs sustain the workload without disallowed thermal, power, ECC, driver or platform failure.

historical_reviews.v3: SOURCE_CONFLICT because procedure says 12 hours while Machine Time is 240 minutes.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Qualified operator controls chamber, rail fixture and measurements; approved burn/telemetry may run automatically.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Procedure's 12-hour burn and +5%/40 C conditions are retained; 240-minute Machine Time is planning metadata unless the owner declares it normative.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Fixture SOP, GPU matrix, actual duration/limits and approved burn profile.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Any approved shorter run is reported as a project override; it does not silently satisfy 12-hour Master coverage.

original_method: Preserve physical environmental/rail method and GPU burn intent.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the project-qualified burn tool and synchronized chamber/rail/GPU telemetry after manual fixture verification.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Fixture SOP, GPU tool manual and platform limits.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No Redfish or telemetry-only substitute for the burn.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Overvoltage, heat and full-GPU load require measured hard stops.

safety_boundaries: No energizing until independent rail measurement and target verification
Stop on safety limit or loss of control
no_automatic_retry: Preserve the first anomaly and do not restart or reduce load without approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: Engineer decides whether Actual and coverage satisfy the project plan.
review_improvement: V3.1 removes the false blocking SOURCE_CONFLICT caused solely by Machine Time while preserving the 12-hour Master default, override delta and every physical safety requirement.
